operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the complete finite-surjection classification as ledger 1281
operations.body: Ledger 1281 completes the algebraic classification for arbitrary finite surjections q:G->H. With kernel K and conjugation image A_q=im(G->Aut(K)), every basis-level power-Mackey fiber square commutes iff gcd(n,exp K*exp A_q)=1. The extension cocycle changes only target translation g^n; fiber bijectivity is controlled by the twisted conjugation word. Nonsplit noncentral Q16->C2 and split D16->C2 have identical odd spectra across 12,288 checks. This supersedes the split and central special cases. No ring Adams, physical chain transfer, or build is claimed.
